s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic respiratory symptoms with hemoptysis and systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Productive cough with occasional hemoptysis and epistaxis
Spiculated mass in the right lower zone on chest radiograph
Cavitating mass in the right lower lobe with bilateral small cavitating nodules on CT
key_facts: History of hypertension and treated tuberculosis
Chest radiograph showed a spiculated 3.5 cm mass in the right lower zone
CT of the thorax demonstrated a 5 cm cavitating mass in the right lower lobe
Bilateral small cavitating nodules on CT
Biopsy showed necrotizing granulomatous inflammation without evidence of malignancy
Treatment switched to high-dose intravenous cyclophosphamide with oral prednisolone

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic respiratory symptoms with hemoptysis and systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Productive cough with occasional hemoptysis and epistaxis
Spiculated mass in the right lower zone on chest radiograph
Cavitating mass in the right lower lobe with bilateral small cavitating nodules on CT
key_facts: History of hypertension and treated tuberculosis
Chest radiograph showed a spiculated 3.5 cm mass in the right lower zone
CT of the thorax demonstrated a 5 cm cavitating mass in the right lower lobe
Bilateral small cavitating nodules on CT
Biopsy showed necrotizing granulomatous inflammation without evidence of malignancy
Treatment switched to high-dose intravenous cyclophosphamide with oral prednisolone

differentials: Squamous cell carcinoma of the lung
Small cell carcinoma of the lung
per_call: Squamous cell carcinoma of the lung
Small cell carcinoma of the lung

shortlist.label: Wegener's granulomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Necrotizing granulomatous inflammation and cavitating lung masses are consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Churg-Strauss syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis is a consideration given the patient's asthma-like symptoms and systemic inflammation

shortlist.label: Microscopic polyangiitis
shortlist.why_kept: Renal impairment and systemic inflammation suggest this diagnosis as a possibility

shortlist.label: Pulmonary tuberculosis
shortlist.why_kept: History of treated tuberculosis and presence of cavitating lung masses make this a consideration

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Necrotizing granulomatous inflammation and bilateral lung involvement are consistent with this diagnosis

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with a cavitating lung mass, bilateral small cavitating nodules, and necrotizing granulomatous inflammation on biopsy, along with a positive cytoplasmic ANCA titre and elevated PR3 level, is most consistent with Wegener's granulomatosis, now known as granulomatosis with polyangiitis (GPA).

rejected.label: Churg-Strauss syndrome
rejected.why: The lack of significant eosinophilia and asthma history makes this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Microscopic polyangiitis
rejected.why: The presence of granulomatous inflammation is not typical of microscopic polyangiitis.

rejected.label: Pulmonary tuberculosis
rejected.why: The patient has a history of treated tuberculosis, but the current presentation and biopsy results are not consistent with active tuberculosis.

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: The presence of cavitating lesions and necrotizing granulomatous inflammation is not typical of sarcoidosis, which usually presents with non-caseating granulomas.
